rationale: The workflow already implements the supported workflow_yaml optimizations backed by measured evidence. The single job is already bounded with `timeout-minutes: 30` (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT), and npm dependencies are already cached via `actions/setup-node` with `cache: 'npm'` (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE). The history-derived timeout pattern (P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT) cannot be applied because CI history contains only one run and it was cancelled, so there is no representative successful-duration history from which to derive a safer lower timeout. All remaining patterns are out of scope (ci_service/build_configuration), require matrices/schedules/tests/Bazel that this workflow lacks, or have unmet preconditions (e.g., unused-output removal requires confirmed downstream consumers, but the packaged VSIX artifact is likely needed by release workflows). Build and test coverage is preserved, so no change is warranted.
